dict.string: Island shows a live mirror from your camera in the Camera tab so you can check yourself before a call. The camera is only on while that tab is visible.
Island shows your calendar's events in the Calendar tab and announces an event a few minutes before it starts. Your events stay on this Mac and Island never changes them.

Island turns down the sound of one app at a time when you move that app's slider in the Stats tab. It only listens to an app while its volume is turned down, and the sound never leaves your Mac.
Island shows a small indicator in the notch while a Focus mode (like Do Not Disturb) is on.
Island watches your screenshot folder (the Desktop by default) so new screenshots appear on the shelf.
